title: Step Oracle Characterization
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $x$ be a finite bit string, and let $r,u,v\in\mathbb N$. The step oracle associated with $N$ returns true on the nested encoding of $x$ and the binary representations of $r,u,v$ if and only if the encoded pair of configurations with codes $u$ and $v$, at window size $r$, belongs to the step language of $N$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols
